verdicts.reason: I prefer A by a small margin. Its headline and subcopy are tightly grouped and stripes show on both sides of the lime panel, as in the original. But the CTA is jammed right against the end of 'price', and the '48H ONLY' badge text is tiny. B's CTA pill is oversized and competes with the headline. Its subcopy is very small, sits too low near the bottom edge, and is separated from the headline by a big gap. The lime panel runs flush to the right edge, so the layout feels lopsided.
